# Phase 7 Dashboard Checklist: QuickFlow Personal Productivity Workspace

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality check for the Phase 7 (User Story 5 - See everything on a dashboard) acceptance criteria AS1-AS7, FR-026, FR-027 and SC-004 used by loop-3 testing: greeting, task / habit / plan / learning metrics, live updates and quick-add actions.
**Created**: 2026-10-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Defaults applied (non-interactive): depth Standard, audience Reviewer (testing loop), focus US5 metric definitions + live update / consistency with underlying data.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are all dashboard sections (greeting, four metric cards, due today, overdue, completed today, completion %, habit checklist, in-progress plans, learning snapshot, quick-add) enumerated in one requirement? [Completeness, Spec §FR-026]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is the content of each summary metric card (tasks, habits, plans, learning) specified, including which number is primary? [Gap, Spec §FR-026]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are the learning snapshot fields (cards in progress, total and completed milestones, milestones in the last 7 days) fully listed? [Completeness, Spec §US5 AS5]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are upcoming / completed plan counts required on the dashboard, or only in-progress plans? [Gap, Spec §US5 AS4]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are loading and load-failure states of the dashboard specified? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is the greeting's time-of-day rule (morning / afternoon / evening / night boundaries) defined? [Gap, Spec §US5 AS1]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 - Is "task completion percentage = Done ÷ all non-archived tasks" defined with a rounding rule and the zero-task result? [Clarity, Spec §US5 AS2]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is "completed today" defined by completion timestamp in the user's local day (not by due date)? [Clarity, Spec §US5 AS2]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is "done-for-current-period" defined for daily vs weekly habits, including the week start? [Clarity, Spec §US5 AS3]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is "milestones completed in the last 7 days" defined as a rolling 7×24 h window or 7 calendar days? [Ambiguity, Spec §US5 AS5]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is "cards in progress" defined as status In Progress (manual or derived)? [Clarity, Spec §US5 AS5]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is "without a manual reload" quantified with a maximum staleness for changes made outside the current tab? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-027]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 - Is the overdue rule on the dashboard the same as on the Tasks page (due before today and not Done, archived excluded)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §US5 AS2]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is the habit toggle on the dashboard governed by the same completed-today / weekly rules as the Habits page? [Consistency, Spec §US2, §US5 AS3]
- [ ] CHK015 - Is plan progress and rest time on the dashboard the same rule as on the Todo Plans page (done ÷ total, end − now)? [Consistency, Spec §US4 AS3, §US5 AS4]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is the in-progress plans order on the dashboard consistent with the plans ordering rule (priority, then start)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK017 - Are archived tasks and inactive habits excluded consistently from all dashboard lists and counts? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, §US2 AS6]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK018 - Can "all metrics match the underlying data" be measured by comparing each number with counts derived from the list endpoints? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004, §US5 AS6]
- [ ] CHK019 - Is the habits metric (done for current period vs completed today) defined unambiguously so it can be checked against data? [Measurability, Spec §US5 AS3]
- [ ] CHK020 - Is the quick-add outcome (which create form opens for task, habit, learning card, plan) objectively verifiable? [Measurability, Spec §US5 AS7]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 - Are requirements defined for in-place actions on the dashboard (complete task, toggle habit, toggle plan item) and their effect on metrics? [Coverage, Spec §US5 AS3, §US4 AS3]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are requirements defined for changes made on other pages being reflected when returning to the dashboard? [Coverage, Spec §US5 AS6]
- [ ] CHK023 - Is the behaviour defined when a plan starts or ends while the dashboard is open? [Coverage, Spec §US5 AS4]
- [ ] CHK024 - Is the effect of a dashboard plan-item toggle on source tasks / habits (FR-024 side effects) reflected in the dashboard requirements? [Coverage, Spec §FR-024]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK025 - Are empty states specified (no tasks, no habits, no in-progress plans, no learning cards)? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK026 - Is the day rollover (midnight) behaviour of due-today / overdue / completed-today defined? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK027 - Is the behaviour defined when a quick-add create is cancelled or fails? [Edge Case, Spec §US5 AS7]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK028 - Are animation limits for count-up and staggered entrance aligned with the global ≤ 250 ms / reduced-motion rule? [Consistency, Spec §FR-032]
- [ ] CHK029 - Are accessible names for metric cards and in-place controls required (values announced without intermediate count-up numbers)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-034]
- [ ] CHK030 - Is the dashboard layout at 375 px width covered by the responsive requirement? [Coverage, Spec §FR-032]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK031 - Is the source of "today" (server clock vs browser local date) and its time zone documented? [Assumption]
- [ ] CHK032 - Is the dependency on the Settings display name (and its default "Friend") for the greeting documented? [Dependency, Spec §US5 AS1, §FR-029]

## Notes

- Items are evaluated by a reviewer; `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers.
